user_direction: Return to the old model and isolate architecture changes. Preserve interrupted Muon work; defer the remaining optimizer and numerical-repair studies.
embedding_rms: Add parameter-free RMS only to token embeddings, preserving the tied readout tensor. Residual branches and attention remain original.

ssmax: Multiply normalized queries after fixed RoPE by log(visible keys), retaining the original fixed per-head gain exp(log_alpha)/d, approximately1/sqrt(d). Keep original embeddings and unnormalized, unit-scaled residual branches. No inverse-width override.

Native AdamW(.9,.98),epsilon1e-8,case weight decay,LR2,50completed-update warmup from zero then constant. Fixed data/seeds/batches/budgets/exact full-heldout scoring and cadence.
